method: Controller read every move explanation, candidate decision and rationale against the source and exact local catalog. No-tag explanations name source-specific qualifications and distinguish support gaps from defined defects. Independent acceptances are retained for anonymous adjudication, not imposed by the controller.
correction: Exactly two equal context leaves changed from first-person invented speech to third-person editorial voice. All decisions, rationales, source judgments and other fields proven unchanged.
sourceBoundaries: No excluded host-dependent claims or missing-reply inferences. Genuine spoken memory qualifiers remain assessable; recognition errors do not.
